section_title: Statutory Compensation, Harassment and Sexual Harassment

nodes.label: Statutory Compensation, Harassment and Sexual Harassment
nodes.summary: Statutory torts including employees' compensation, discrimination, harassment, sexual harassment, and related statutory compensation schemes.

nodes.label: Employees' Compensation Scheme
nodes.summary: The Employees' Compensation Ordinance (Cap. 459) provides no-fault compensation for injury arising out of and in the course of employment. Claims are assessed by the Employees' Compensation Board or through the District Court.

nodes.label: Occupational Disease Compensation
nodes.summary: The ECO provides specific compensation schedules for occupational diseases. Prescribed diseases listed in the Ordinance. Proof of causation and employment exposure is required.

nodes.label: Sex Discrimination
nodes.summary: The Sex Discrimination Ordinance (Cap. 480) prohibits discrimination on grounds of sex, marital status, and pregnancy. Covers employment, education, provision of goods/services, and accommodation. Enforced by the Equal Opportunities Commission.

nodes.label: Disability Discrimination
nodes.summary: The Disability Discrimination Ordinance (Cap. 487) prohibits discrimination against persons with disabilities in employment, education, and access to goods/services. Reasonable accommodation may be required.

nodes.label: Family Status and Race Discrimination
nodes.summary: The SDO (Cap. 480) also prohibits family status discrimination. The Race Discrimination Ordinance (Cap. 602) prohibits race-based discrimination. Both enforced by the Equal Opportunities Commission.

nodes.label: Sexual Harassment
nodes.summary: Sexual harassment is a form of sex discrimination under the SDO (Cap. 480). Includes unwelcome sexual advances, requests for sexual favours, and other verbal or physical conduct of a sexual nature that creates an intimidating/hostile environment.

nodes.label: Harassment at Common Law
nodes.summary: HK does not have a standalone common law tort of harassment. Harassment may be actionable via trespass to person, nuisance, intimidation, or via the Protection from Harassment Ordinance (Cap. 583) if applicable.

nodes.label: Protection from Harassment Ordinance
nodes.summary: The Protection from Harassment Ordinance (Cap. 583) creates a statutory tort of harassment and provides for injunctions, damages and criminal sanctions. Requires a course of conduct amounting to harassment.

nodes.label: EOC Procedures and Remedies
nodes.summary: The Equal Opportunities Commission investigates complaints of discrimination and harassment, attempts conciliation, and may provide legal assistance. Remedies include damages (including injury to feelings), injunctions, and declarations.

nodes.label: Criminal Injuries Compensation
nodes.summary: The Criminal and Law Enforcement Injuries Compensation Scheme provides ex gratia compensation to victims of violent crime. Not a common law tort but a parallel compensation mechanism.

nodes.label: Sex Discrimination Ordinance (Cap. 480)
nodes.summary: Prohibits sex, marital status, pregnancy and family status discrimination, and sexual harassment. Enforced by the Equal Opportunities Commission.

nodes.label: Disability Discrimination Ordinance (Cap. 487)
nodes.summary: Prohibits disability discrimination in employment, education, and access to goods/services. Enforced by the Equal Opportunities Commission.

nodes.label: Race Discrimination Ordinance (Cap. 602)
nodes.summary: Prohibits race-based discrimination and harassment. Enforced by the Equal Opportunities Commission.

nodes.label: Protection from Harassment Ordinance (Cap. 583)
nodes.summary: Creates a statutory tort of harassment and provides civil remedies including injunctions and damages, plus criminal sanctions.

nodes.label: Verify HK Discrimination and Harassment Cases
nodes.summary: Research and verify HK EOC decisions and court cases on sexual harassment, sex discrimination, disability discrimination, and Protection from Harassment Ordinance.
